title: Dynamic Questionnaire + AI-assisted Evidence Collector and Contract Template Orchestration
creator: Alexandra Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise procurement is slowed by multiple touchpoints during vendor onboarding: long security questionnaires, manual evidence collection, inconsistent contract clauses for data processing and insurance requirements. We need a product experiment that reduces time-to-acceptance for low/medium-risk vendors while preserving legal and SOC2 evidence standards for high-risk vendors.

Goal: Build a dynamic questionnaire engine (conditional branching) + an AI-assisted evidence collector that helps vendors attach or extract required artifacts, then map answers to a risk score and pick a contract template (standard, enhanced DPA, insurance-backed SLA). The system should surface confidence and missing-evidence gaps to internal procurement reviewers and optionally call an insurance-broker API to fetch pre-approved insurance endorsements.

Scope: MVP covers vendor portal UI, questionnaire DSL and rules engine, evidence extractor (OCR + key-value heuristics), risk-mapping ruleset for SOC2 controls subset, contract template selector, and integrations: cloud storage for artifacts, internal PRD/Drive links, and a partner insurance API sandbox. Not in scope: full legal negotiation workflow, multi-signer contract execution, or running a full SOC2 audit.

Success metrics: 30% reduction in median vendor time-to-complete onboarding for low/medium risk; 40% fewer manual evidence requests per vendor; pilot partner (2 customers) sign-off on acceptance criteria for contract templates and insurance flow.

Key stakeholders: Procurement lead, Legal (contracts), Security (SOC2 controls SME), Sales (enterprise onboarding), Engineering (Platform + Console), Design (vendor portal UX).
acceptance_criteria: Questionnaire supports conditional branching based on previous answers and vendor type
Evidence collector accepts uploaded PDFs/PNGs and returns extracted artifact metadata with confidence scores
Risk mapper produces stable risk band (low/medium/high) and recommended contract template
Procurement reviewers can see per-question missing evidence and confidence and can request a specific artifact from vendor
Optional insurance API call returns available endorsements and estimated premium placeholders for procurement review
Telemetry emitted for time-to-complete, manual-request rate, and conversion to signed contract (pilot customers)
steps: Design wireframes for vendor portal flow and reviewer dashboard
Define questionnaire DSL with conditional rules and SOC2 control mappings
Implement evidence extractor microservice (use Tesseract prototype + heuristics) and schema for artifact metadata
Create risk-mapping ruleset and contract-template matrix with Legal
Integrate partner insurance sandbox and stub API in staging
Build reviewer-facing UI for manual override and comments
Run closed pilot with two vendors and two customers, collect feedback, iterate

notes: Trade-offs discussed: full NLP-based evidence validation is out of scope for MVP due to false positive risk; prefer confidence-scored metadata + human-in-loop for final acceptance.
Fallback policy: if insurance API unavailable, surface pre-approved carrier list and mark vendor for manual insurance verification
Privacy consideration: artifacts stored in encrypted bucket with retention policy 90 days for pilot; Legal to sign off on retention and deletion policy
Follow-ups: schedule a joint Legal-Security working session to finalize SOC2 mappings and contract clause matrix (target 2025-03-18)
